description:
This instance of the HANAMI Reproducibility Workflow executed 22 members of the [NICAM-DC](https://github.com/nicamdc-dev/nicamdc/tree/master) model running the [ICOMEX_JW test with 10 MPI ranks](https://github.com/nicamdc-dev/nicamdc/tree/master/test/case/ICOMEX_JW/gl05rl00z40pe10).

Its purpose was to test the ability of [Flux](https://flux-framework.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html) in handling the execution of multiple concurrent MPI processes with a climate model in two nodes of MareNostrum 5.
name: HANAMI Reproducibility Workflow Running NICAM-DC with 22 Identical Members of the ICOMEX_JW Test on 10 Cores Running with the Flux Resource Manager in the Same Allocation
